label: Record
intro: `text` lists records about people and organizations, numbered from 1. A record stands for the person or organization it names first.

items.text: Amara Okafor founded Kestrel Labs and still leads its research team.
Kestrel Labs, a freight brokerage.
Dana Whitfield started Brookline Shipping and manages its Boston desk.
Brookline Shipping, a coastal carrier.
Marcus Bell co-founded Grayline Trust and chairs its board.
Grayline Trust, a small foundation.
Elif Demir established Fenwick Studio and runs its design desk.
Fenwick Studio, a print shop.
June Adeyemi founded Hull Harbour Analytics and heads its data team.
Hull Harbour Analytics, a consultancy.
Tomas Reyes set up Pier 39 Logistics and directs its night operations.
Pier 39 Logistics, a warehouse operator.
Priya Nair founded Rotterdam Port Services and manages its scheduling.
Rotterdam Port Services, a stevedoring firm.
Oskar Lind started Karst and Vellum and leads its editorial board.
Karst and Vellum, a publisher.
Sofia Marino founded Sausalito Ferry Lines and captains its flagship.
Sausalito Ferry Lines, a ferry operator.
Ahmed Farouk established Cedar Point Advisors and heads its audit team.
Cedar Point Advisors, an accounting firm.
Lena Fischer founded Millbrook Rowing Club and coaches its senior squad.
Millbrook Rowing Club, a sports club.
Grace Otieno founded Quiet Ward Press and edits its poetry list.
Quiet Ward Press, a small press.
